D2b_zoya_marker_collides.quote: capture STEP 2 'Example: "Rhea (Value360) to Zoya: offers 14 or 16 Oct ..."' vs STEP 0 / actions STEP 1 'a Summary neither starting "Zoya" nor holding " to Zoya: "'
D2b_zoya_marker_collides.scenario: A PR replies To Zoya with ad@ in Cc, and capture or the old inbox logs it as 'Rhea (Value360) to Zoya: ...'. That's the house format, and it's capture's own example. If the row is one of B10's unlinked old rows, STEP 0 now leaves it unlinked forever, and actions keeps excluding it ('never one with no Engagement and no Deal Captured before 2026-11-02'). If it's an old-inbox row inside the replay window, actions skips it. The Summary can't tell who logged the row, because both routines write '<who> to Zoya:'.
D2b_zoya_marker_collides.fix: Tell the routines apart by provenance, not Summary. Option 1: Zoya's rows are the ones whose Message-ID isn't in ad@ (one email_read search, text = Message-ID). Option 2: if Zoya's routine sets Source or Link differently, use that (check one row of each on Notion before cutover).

D3b_captured_window_replays.quote: actions STEP 1: 'plus rows Captured on or after the day before W's date (capture's STEP 0 rows; they never move W)'
D3b_captured_window_replays.scenario: First run: W = 1 Nov 03:00Z, so the Captured window starts 31 Oct. Every old-inbox mail row Captured 31 Oct or 1 Nov has no 'actions: done' line and passes the old-row clause, so it's worked again. STEP 5 then rewrites Waiting on and Next action from mail that's up to a day and a half stale.
D3b_captured_window_replays.fix: Add 'and whose body has a "capture:" line' to the Captured window. STEP 0 always stamps it, so only STEP 0 rows come in that way.

D9_zoya_logged_ad_mail_never_worked.quote: capture IDENTITY: 'Any other id that comes back already has its Activity: create nothing, and never change its Kind, Summary or author (only add a missing link)' + preamble: 'Every mail Activity you create, re-key or link (STEP 0) ends its page body with the line "capture: <run id>"' + actions: 'Yours only: its body has a "capture:" line'
D9_zoya_logged_ad_mail_never_worked.scenario: This was already present in round 3; I missed it then. A guest replies-all at 10:30 to a mail from Zoya, so ad@ and Zoya both get it ('Akshay is in Cc on every mail of hers'). Zoya's :38 run logs it first as 'Guest to Zoya: agrees 14 Nov'. At 11:02 capture finds the msgid: row and creates nothing, and writes no 'capture:' line. Actions never works it, so STEP 3's status moves (Booked, a sponsored no to They declined, a precall happened, Akshay's decision 'a mail to Zoya') never fire. Any ad@ mail that lands between :02 and :38 and also reaches Zoya is exposed. The old inbox worked every ad@ message it read, whoever had logged it.
D9_zoya_logged_ad_mail_never_worked.fix: In capture STEP 2: 'an existing row that another routine logged for a message you read in ad@ gets your "capture: <run id>" line appended (and its missing links); never its Summary or Kind'. Actions then works it. Its 6e checks the thread, so it won't re-queue a reply Zoya already sent.

verdict: Not accepted yet. Round 3b fixes D1, D2 (for Zoya's own rows), D4, D5, D6, D7 and D8 and the stale items, and every round 3 case still passes. Three wording defects are left. D3b (blocking): the Captured window still pulls in old-inbox rows Captured 31 Oct to 1 Nov, so they're worked again. D2b (should fix): the ' to Zoya: ' marker matches capture's own Summary convention and strands ad@ rows addressed to Zoya. D9 (blocking, carried over from round 3): ad@ mail that Zoya's routine logs first never gets a 'capture:' line, so actions never works it. Each is a one-clause fix within the 1,351 bytes actions has left. Replay D3b, D9 and B10 after the fix.
